title: Pasado continuo: I was cooking when…
short: was / were + verbo con -ing: lo que estaba pasando en un momento del pasado, a menudo interrumpido por otra acción.

story.title: La película en marcha
story.text: Imagina que pulsas «pausa» en un momento del pasado. Lo que se estaba haciendo en ese instante va en ==pasado continuo==: was / were + -ing.

examples.t: At nine, I was cooking dinner.
examples.es: A las nueve estaba haciendo la cena.

story.title: Cómo se forma
story.text: Es el to be en pasado (==was / were==) + verbo con ==-ing==. Igual que el presente continuo, pero en pasado.

story.title: Larga + corta
story.text: La acción ==larga== (en marcha) va en pasado continuo. La acción ==corta== que la interrumpe, en pasado simple. When va con la corta; while, con la larga.

examples.t: I was cooking when the phone rang.
examples.es: Estaba cocinando cuando sonó el teléfono.

examples.t: While I was shopping, I met an old friend.
examples.es: Mientras hacía la compra, me encontré a una vieja amiga.

story.title: Para describir la escena
story.text: Al empezar una historia, el pasado continuo pinta el ==fondo==: el tiempo, lo que hacía la gente. Luego, en pasado simple, lo que ==pasó==.

examples.t: It was raining and people were running. Then I saw him.
examples.es: Llovía y la gente corría. Entonces lo vi.

story.title: Así en español, así en inglés
story.text: «Estaba cocinando» = ==was cooking==. Pero nuestro imperfecto «cocinaba» tiene dos caras: si es costumbre → ==used to cook==; si estaba en marcha → ==was cooking==.

examples.t: When I was young, I used to cook a lot.
I was cooking when you arrived.

story.title: Errores típicos
story.text:
❌ When I cooked, the phone rang. ✅ When I ==was cooking==, the phone rang.
❌ I was cook. ✅ I was cook==ing==.
❌ We was walking. ✅ We ==were== walking.
❌ I was knowing. ✅ I ==knew==.

story.title: Verbos que no se alargan
story.text: Know, like, want, need, believe… expresan estados, no acciones: no van con -ing. ==I knew== the answer, no «I was knowing».

compare.es: En español usamos «estaba + gerundio» (estaba cocinando) o el imperfecto (cocinaba) para lo que estaba en marcha. El imperfecto también sirve para costumbres.
compare.target: En inglés, lo que estaba en marcha va en pasado continuo: was / were + -ing (I was cooking). Las costumbres del pasado van con used to o con el pasado simple, no con el continuo.

errors.wrong: When I cooked, the phone rang.
errors.right: When I was cooking, the phone rang.
errors.why: La acción que estaba en marcha va en pasado continuo.
Después de was / were, el verbo lleva -ing.

errors.wrong: We was walking in the park.
errors.right: We were walking in the park.
errors.why: Con we, you y they: were.
Know es un estado: no se usa con -ing.

errors.wrong: When I was little, I was playing in the street every day.
errors.right: When I was little, I used to play in the street every day.
errors.why: Para costumbres repetidas se usa used to, no el continuo.

errors.wrong: While I cooked, my son was laying the table.
errors.right: While I was cooking, my son was laying the table.
errors.why: Dos acciones largas a la vez: las dos en pasado continuo.

exercises.q: At eight o'clock I ___ having dinner.
My friends ___ waiting for me at the station.
I was reading when the doorbell ___.
exercises.why: La acción corta que interrumpe: pasado simple.

exercises.q: While we ___ dinner, the lights went out.
exercises.why: While + acción larga en pasado continuo.

exercises.q: It ___ heavily when we left the restaurant.
exercises.why: Describe el fondo de la escena: was raining.

exercises.q: I ___ the answer, so I put my hand up.
exercises.why: Know es un estado: no va con -ing.

exercises.q: When I was a child, we ___ in the river every summer.
exercises.why: Costumbre repetida: used to, no el continuo.

exercises.q: She was ___ the dog when she met her neighbour.
exercises.es: Estaba paseando al perro cuando se encontró a su vecina.

exercises.q: We ___ talking about you when you called!
I ___ sleeping. I was just resting my eyes!
exercises.es: No estaba durmiendo. ¡Solo descansaba la vista!

exercises.q: What ___ you doing at midnight?
The sun was ___ and the birds were singing.
exercises.es: Brillaba el sol y cantaban los pájaros.

exercises.q: I ___ when you sent the message.
We ___ on the terrace when it started to rain.
You ___ to me!
She was working yesterday afternoon.
answer: She was not working yesterday afternoon.

exercises.q: They were playing in the garden.
answer: Were they playing in the garden?

exercises.q: I am watching a film.
I was driving. My phone rang.
answer: I was driving when my phone rang.

exercises.q: I was making coffee. I burnt my hand.
answer: I burnt my hand while I was making coffee.
While I was making coffee, I burnt my hand.
I burned my hand while I was making coffee.
While I was making coffee, I burned my hand.
exercises.why: While va con la acción larga.

exercises.q: I was cook dinner when you arrived.
We was walking along the beach.
She were sleeping when I got home.
My friends was playing cards in the bar.
I was having a shower when somebody knock at the door.
exercises.why: La acción corta que interrumpe va en pasado simple: somebody knocked.

exercises.es: Estaba haciendo la compra cuando te vi
exercises.answer: I was doing the shopping when I saw you
What were you doing at ten
While I was sleeping it started to snow
exercises.why: While + pasado continuo, y lo que pasó en pasado simple.

exercises.q: Estaba conduciendo cuando sonó el teléfono.
answer: I was driving when the phone rang.
I was driving when my phone rang.

exercises.q: ¿Estabas durmiendo?
We were having lunch when the phone rang.
answer: Estábamos comiendo cuando sonó el teléfono.
Estábamos almorzando cuando sonó el teléfono.
exercises.why: Were having = estábamos comiendo; rang = sonó.

exercises.context: Tu amiga te pregunta por qué no contestaste el WhatsApp. Estabas conduciendo.
exercises.why: Explicas lo que estabas haciendo en ese momento: was driving.

exercises.context: Empiezas a contar una anécdota: llovía y paseabais por el puerto.
options: It was raining and we were walking by the harbour.
It rained and we walked by the harbour every day.
It used to rain and we were walk by the harbour.
exercises.answer: It was raining and we were walking by the harbour.
exercises.why: Para pintar la escena: pasado continuo.
Une las dos partes de cada frase.

exercises.title: Una tarde con sorpresa
exercises.text: Last Sunday I was making a cake and my grandchildren were playing in the garden. Suddenly, the doorbell rang. It was my old school friend! She was visiting the town and wanted to say hello.
exercises.why: Was making y were playing pintan la escena; rang es lo que pasó.

exercises.t: While I was cooking, the children were playing in the garden.
exercises.es: Mientras yo cocinaba, los niños jugaban en el jardín.
